text: SMG is the largest facility manager in North America and in recent years has grown its business to add to its portfolio international convention centres, trade show venues, theatres, stadium and arenas throughout North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, and South America. From 1997 to 2007, the partnership of O&Y/SMG managed Enercare Centre and in 2007 this relationship changed to an official affiliation. In 2014, Exhibition Place renewed its agreement with SMG for a four-year term beginning on January 1, 2015 and Enercare Centre and Beanfield Centre have continued to benefit from the relationship. In 2017, Exhibition Place received marketing benefits from SMG that were in the range of $85,000 to $95,000 US as SMG had either promoted Enercare Centre and Beanfield Centre through printed publications and/or at tradeshow forums hosted by SMG.
